name: Ruin Coffin
notes: Lich-room coffin. The Lid part slides off when its skeleton rises (animated by the sanctum runtime from the lid rest position).

seatLegModel.sourcePose: equal fixed bones; thigh projected flush to the area-weighted average seat plane; calf stays exactly straight while the knee is over the seat footprint and bends exactly 90 degrees only after clearing the edge
seatLegModel.footSource: scratchbones-config proceduralFeet species GLBs or exact generated runtime fallback
seatLegModel.coordinateSpace: actor floor-relative; PNGPlaneAvatar visual model lifted portraitModelHeight/2 as required by its authored portrait-space anchors
seatLegModel.posteriorSource: species+gender attachment-rig heightPercentOffset applied to PNGPlaneAvatar portrait-derived handAttachY/baseY
seatLegModel.handAttachYFallback: local alpha-bottom scan using PNGPlaneAvatar placement formula, then the profile heightPercentOffset
seatLegModel.legSpacingSource: runtime torso-only widest-opaque-row pixel scan, cached by species+gender
seatLegModel.anchorDifference: measured posterior is directly verified against the authored chair seat anchor
seatLegModel.hipDifference: semantic 90-degree seated hip turn is solved directly as a thigh tangent to the averaged seat plane
seatLegModel.seatSurfaceRule: recognized seat faces contribute an area-weighted average normal; each thigh is projected to that plane with 0.001 clearance
seatLegModel.calfRule: two-state seated chain: calf is exactly collinear with the thigh while the knee projection remains inside the seat-face bounds; exact 90-degree drop opposite the average normal after the knee clears the edge
seatLegModel.anchorLocalYRule: seat-anchor normal offset is authored per anchor; new and reset anchors use the adjusted-chair-derived 0.01 default
seatLegModel.backrestRule: seat backrests are shortened from the top while preserving their lower attachment; target height is 1.10 times seat depth, so bench width is never used
seatLegModel.edgeBehavior: seat-face footprint bounds determine whether the calf remains straight or drops 90 degrees; no furniture-edge raycast is needed
seatLegModel.standingComparison: per-avatar optional linked half-width viewport using the runtime standing leg solver, posterior marker, outer-box edges, and optional billboarded numeric labels
seatLegModel.posteriorAdjustmentPreview: per-avatar non-destructive portrait-relative draft with draggable 2D guide, exact numeric fields, one-tap posterior-X centering between live left/right leg X values, live seated/standing preview, persisted override, repository reset, and copyable attachment-profile patch
seatLegModel.portraitFogMask: global authoring toggle removes fighter.opacityMaskLayer from every generated front/rear portrait without changing the deterministic avatar profile
